MOMOTHECAT.story: Momo, a black cat with yellow eyes, tips her witch's hat and waves her little wand at dusk.

PEWTER.look: A normal four-legged grey tabby cat with dark bars on the cheeks, a white chin and a pink nose, dressed as a forest archer in a pointed green felt cap with a red feather and a belted green tunic. No text or logo.

SAVEPAWS.story: Save Point, a brown tabby kitten in a red headband, roars before every adventure.

OLIVIACAT.story: A Scottish Fold kitten with folded ears, napping in a hammock full of kittens.

UPDATECAT.story: Update Cat, a sturdy grey-brown striped tabby with a black-ringed tail, stalks moths at dusk.
